reader.requirement: At --std 85 the value held by an index-name used as a subscript (bare or index-name +/- integer) corresponds to an occurrence number of its table by a correspondence the implementor defines (here the identity, docs/conformance/7/DOC-A.1-194.md), consistently across SET, SET UP/DOWN, index data items, PERFORM VARYING, SEARCH, relation conditions and multi-dimensional references, including between tables of different element sizes.

edition-consulted.switches: ConstructRegistry Constructs.SubscriptArithmeticExpression2002: the subscript FORM (a noninteger data-name, an arithmetic-expression subscript such as IA + K) is refused at 85 and admitted from 2002; the index value-to-occurrence mapping is not switched

reader.edition-search: Grepped edition/DialectLevel in SubscriptBinder.cs (the one construct gate above, plus the VersionConformancePass parse arm for subscript shape it defers to); the index cell is a long occurrence number at every edition (DOC-A.1-194 / DOC-A.1-128), with no edition input on the read or SET paths probed.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for the correspondence; the admitted subscript forms differ (IA + K is refused at 85, prints a3 at 2023)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers index +1, SET UP, a relation and PERFORM VARYING FROM index; not exercised: SET across tables of different element sizes, index data items, SET numeric TO index, SET DOWN, index-name - integer, two-dimensional indexing, SEARCH, index-to-index relation, out-of-range index values, and the 85 refusals

probes.expected: SET IB TO IA (3-char vs 7-char elements) names occurrence 3 of both; via a USAGE INDEX item likewise; IA+2 / IA-2 occurrences 5 / 1; UP/DOWN move by occurrences; index = 1 and IA = IB compare occurrence numbers; nested PERFORM VARYING fills CL(r,c)=r+c; CL(IR,IC) and CL(IR+1,IC-2); SEARCH leaves IA at occurrence 4
an index set one past either end holds the identity value (6, 0); 1985 leaves the use of such a value undefined (SET GR2), and the implementor's range is the 64-bit occurrence interval (DOC-A.1-128)

probes.printed: COBOL1961: 'EA' subscripted by the index-name 'IB', which is not in the INDEXED BY phrase of any OCCURS clause in this item's hierarchy
COBOL1637: 'IA' is an index-name, which is not an identifier (MOVE 3 TO IA; COMPUTE IA = 2)
probes.expected: an index is modified only by PERFORM, SEARCH and SET (§1985:IV.4.3.8.2.4 GR3): refused

probes.printed: 85: COBOL0900 the arithmetic-expression subscript requires COBOL-2002; 2023: a3
probes.expected: the 2002 arithmetic-expression subscript IA + K refused at 85

citations.check: OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.2.4 GR2  (4.3.8.2.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: The implementor's correspondence is the identity (an index holds its 1-based occurrence number in a long; docs/conformance/7/DOC-A.1-194.md), and every index use probed at 85 agrees with it, including cross-table SET between different element sizes, where a displacement model would differ. The only edition switch on the subscript path gates subscript forms, which 85 refuses correctly.
